profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Academia.edu
profile.summary:
With around ten years of experience in software development as both an engineer and manager, I have developed and launched innovative web applications that solve real-world problems across multiple domains and technology stacks.

I am currently a Senior Software Engineer at Academia, a company that is an open-access platform working to bring the world's research online, available to all, for free. We're on a mission to accelerate global research.

My mission is to use my technical skills and leadership to create impactful solutions that can improve the world around us.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Founding member of the AI Coding team which drives the integration of AI coding tools and methodologies across the team.
● Worked on the initial infrastructure for safely and securely running agents headlessly with full access to our legacy stack.
● Developed key skills and MCP integrations for accelerating development, particularly focused on key workflows such as Figma design to final implementation with automated validation via skills for reusability.
● Gave multiple internal talks on how to best use AI coding tools to accelerate internal adoption
● Developed a vibe coding environment and skills for use by non-technical team members to be able to write higher quality code that meets best practices
● Developed agentic workflows for a variety of products such as generation of podcasts, slideshows, videos, etc. based on academic papers
● Responsible for LLM cost tracking and forecasting for all coding and product use cases across the organization

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Built a public tool called TrialPioneer to allow users to virtually design clinical trials in various disease areas to get an understanding of sample size, power, and other variables related to their trial. Most importantly, they could then see how Unlearn’s models could aid in making their clinical trials more effective.
● Built a product platform from 0 to 1 to deliver and emphasize the value of Unlearn’s clinical trial product suite in the planning and execution phases of clinical trials
● The platform generated 30+ opportunities to partner with pharmaceutical companies on their upcoming trials

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
● Led the patient recruitment team to reduce the time to launch new recruitment campaigns by up to 50%, reduce the rate of incoming issues by 80%, and meet initial candidate recruitment goals by planning and building a new end to end patient recruitment platform working cross functionally with product, design, and internal clinical trial ops teams.
● Advocated and executed on significant changes to the tech stack (Flask monorepo to service oriented NestJS applications) to increase development velocity, reduce coupling between our application data models, and decrease time to deploy in partnership with SRE. Reduced average time of the CI/CD pipeline from ~1 hour to ~10 minutes in the new tech stack.
● Architected and launched the first two applications in the new service oriented tech stack. This approach was templated for use across other internal engineering teams which led to two further applications being launched to production within months.
● Developed AI / GPT chat bot to collect requisite data from clinical trial applicants to determine if they are eligible for a trial.
● Developed AI / GPT chat bot to answer questions about a given clinical trial based on our knowledge base.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Node.js · Docker · Terraform · Distributed Systems · Flask · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · NestJS · TypeScript · Apache Kafka · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
● Managed and mentored a team of on average five engineers that executed on projects across the Splash product.
● Managed back end guild meetings which built consensus on how to navigate larger scale change in our architecture. Led to tangible impacts such as migrating from CakePHP to Symfony and development of our first microservices in NodeJS. Reduced time spent in our CI/CD pipelines by up to 80% in these new applications.
● Established observability dashboards, SLOs, and SLIs to set tangible goals for queue performance with our clients. Mitigated churn of multi million dollars of business through oversight of three engineering teams that addressed blockage and delay issues in our task queueing system. Owned the project from conception and solution brainstorming to delivery including stakeholder communications.
● Addressed systemic technical debt through advocating for and managing a Stability engineering team with no associated client deliverables to focus on root causes rather than band aids. Resulted in a roadmap of five large scale projects fully led by myself and the engineering team.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
● Hired as one of the first 25 employees, worked across the entire platform during my tenure.
● Developed and iterated on the CRM platform which captured event RSVPs and ticket transactions dealing with tens of thousands of requests per second and millions of dollars in transactions.
● Deeply integrated with clients existing tools by integrating the Splash CRM with third party CRM software such as Salesforce and Marketo.
● Created tools to allow users to send personalized emails to hundreds of thousands of event attendees with high deliverability rates in minutes.
● Decreased at the door check in times by up to 50% through development of an attendee check in and badge printing mobile application.
● Enabled niche use cases by implementing a public facing API for custom integrations built by our clients. Was regularly the point of contact for client calls to find creative solutions.
● Owned a one off feature to enable event attendees to be assigned to hotel accommodations based on user customizable rules to aid the business in closing a seven figure contract.

positions.title: Interactive Developer
positions.description:
● Developed the Human agency website (https://humanig.com).
● Built a landing page for the Hudson Yards real estate project in Manhattan (https://humanig.com/hudsonyards.php). 
● Set up an ecommerce storefront for a swimwear business using Shopify.
● Reduced iteration cycles on final deliverables by up to 50% by developing a Firefox browser extension to visually highlight margin and padding values to allow designers to verify spacing.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive
positions.description:
Took part in a 3 month web development bootcamp where I designed and built web applications using various technologies/resources such as the following:

● Ruby on Rails (3/4)
● Sinatra
● JavaScript (jQuery, AJAX, Underscore.js, Backbone.js, d3.js, ...)
● SQL (PostgreSQL, mySQL)
● NoSQL (MongoDB)
● Website Hosting (AWS, Heroku)
● Test Driven Development
● Version Control (Git)
● Agile Development Environment (PivotalTracker, Trello)
● and more

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Worked primarily on front-end design at www.stylingon.com using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.    

     ● Added elements to the persistent header and footer throughout the site.
     ● Redesigned parts of the quiz and registration process to make it more user friendly.
     ● Created or redesigned many of the pages linked to from the front page.
     ● Debugged some recurring issues throughout the site.

volunteerExperiences.description: I taught science to mentally challenged and hearing deficient students in Mumbai in the form of fun lab experiments.

projects.title: Revenge: The Revenge
projects.description:
Revenge: The Revenge is a retro 2D sidescroller game infleuenced by classics such as Castlevania. It is fully browser based, and built using a JavaScript game engine called MelonJS. The work that has been done so far was completed in a week.

Technologies used:
Rails 3, PostgreSQL, RSpec Testing, MelonJS, Tiled, HTML/CSS

projects.title: The Boom Room
projects.description:
The Boom Room is a social music listening experience. It allows people to create playlists on the fly with groups of friends no matter where you are, and listen to them together at the same time. Using the SoundCloud API, you can search for music and add songs to your group playlist. The bulk of this project was made in one week in a group with one other person.

Technologies used:
Rails 4, Web Sockets, RSpec Testing, PostgreSQL, jQuery, Redis, Masonry, SoundCloud API, HTML/CSS
